toxicMaterial.name: Amanita phalloides poison
toxicMaterial.description: A poisonous mushroom material associated with amatoxins and severe organ toxicity after ingestion. This record does not claim that every mushroom tissue sample has identical toxin concentration.
toxicMaterial.ecologicalRoleSummary: The biological role of amatoxins in the mushroom's ecology remains incompletely characterized.

components.summary: Toxic compounds associated with severe mushroom poisoning after ingestion.
